_doc: Which manifest links each BOM line of the body manifest covers (base link names; L_ / R_ variants included). Read by the bom check. Lines are matched by their id prefix: printed parts (roles printed_structural_connector / carrier) and steel sleeves on these links are counted against the line's quantity. _parts: parts assigned to a line by name, overriding their link (the neck root cradle sits on the torso link but is a neck / head part). _roles: lines counted by part role instead of links (battery fins).
